svg.title: Figma multiplayer: one document, one owner
svg.desc: A high-resolution system design banner showing browser clients sending optimistic edits over WebSockets to a document owner, which orders and validates changes, persists accepted revisions and broadcasts canonical state. Cursor presence uses a separate transient lane. Reported company scale and modeled RPS are distinguished.
svg.text: Server-ordered edits keep the shared canvas responsive.
Two browser edits converge on one document process.
Fast updates can be coalesced or dropped.
The owner commits accepted edits to shared history.
Public Figma engineering references support the architecture; the article separates disclosure from modeled scale.
